scenes.title: Only the Neighbour Next Door
scenes.summary: The Tuesday-night knock turns out to be a neighbour returning a misdelivered city envelope confirming Wednesday's three-o'clock visit.

scenes.title: General in an Apron
scenes.summary: At 6:00 AM Wednesday, Sora sits with her ankle on pillows directing Minsu's bread kneading and Mina's lemon curd like a cheerful general.

scenes.title: Carrots by the Millimetre
scenes.summary: Jihoon chops vegetables with architectural precision for the lentil soup while Minsu and Sora tease him affectionately.

scenes.title: Setting Room Nine
scenes.summary: At half past two on Wednesday, Mina, Youngmi, and Junho lay white linen cloths, stoneware cups, and small lemon branches on the tables in Room 9.

scenes.title: Put the Speech Away
scenes.summary: At 2:55 PM, Sungmin nervously recites a stiff five-page history speech until Mina and Junho convince him to simply welcome the visitor naturally.

scenes.title: The Heritage Stamp
scenes.summary: After inspecting the open gate, sunlit café tables, lending books, and hot tea, the heritage clerk signs the protection form—and asks Youngmi to play.

scenes.title: Toast in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: Listening to Youngmi's piano waltz from the kitchen doorway, Sora, Jihoon, and Minsu clink teacups to celebrate passing the review.

scenes.title: The Tune at the Gate
scenes.summary: At the courtyard gate, Sungmin, Mina, and Youngmi learn the passerby was the violinist neighbor who used to play Friday duets with Sungmin's aunt thirty years ago—and he promises to return Friday at six!
